articles.title: OxygenOS 16: New AI feature revealed, likely debuting with OnePlus 15
articles.description: OnePlus is preparing to launch OxygenOS 16, the latest version of its Android-based custom interface. The company has now revealed that Mind Space, an AI journaling tool in OxygenOS, will integrate Google Gemini. The update is expected to debut on flagship devices soon, with the OnePlus 15 likely being the first phone to ship with OxygenOS 16 and this new Gemini-powered functionality.
